title: Notifications
cardBody: Get an alert on this device when a bundle needs you during your shifts.
shiftNotice: Approver alerts by push and email for your shifts are not affected.
unsupported: This browser does not support push alerts. Use a supported browser.
blockedHelp: Alerts are blocked. Allow notifications for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
iosHelp: On iOS 16.4 or later, add Skyclause to your Home Screen and open it there before turning on alerts.
pushError: Alerts could not be enabled. Check your connection and browser settings, then try again.
stateError: This device could not be checked. Check your connection, then try again.
inboxError: The inbox could not be loaded. Check your connection, then retry.
streamError: Live updates are unavailable. Reconnecting; retry to refresh the inbox.
devicesError: Devices could not be loaded. Check your connection, then retry.
preferencesError: Preferences could not be loaded. Check your connection, then retry.
saveError: This preference was not saved. Check your connection, then try again.
readError: This item could not be marked read. Check your connection, then try again.
emptyInbox: No notifications yet. Check back after your next project update.
emptyDevices: No registered devices. Turn on alerts on this device.
emptyPreferences: No preferences to show. Retry to load your settings.
emptyDevicePage: No devices on this page. Show the first devices.
help: The inbox lists every notification sent to your account. Enable alerts on a device to get them as they happen, and switch off the kinds you do not need.
removed: Removed {label}. It no longer receives alerts for your account.
removeDescription: This device stops receiving alerts for your account at once. Turn alerts on again from that device to bring it back.
